客户端保存全量历史是值得做的后续升级，但不是这里最省事的第一版做法。
不过滤会直接违反避免重复展示这条核心非功能需求。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — while building the feed, check the swiped id set against the swipe table with a contains lookup; the partition key keeps that query hitting just one shard.
The gateway is a stateless routing layer; it shouldn't carry this kind of business-data cache.
Storing the full history on the client is worth doing later, but it isn't the simplest first cut here.
Skipping the filter directly breaks the core non-functional requirement to avoid re-showing profiles.

q: “查滑动库做 contains 过滤”会遇到哪些问题？（多选）
options: 偏可用性的系统里，近期滑动可能尚未同步到所有副本，生成 feed 时漏检 → 有重复展示的风险
滑动历史庞大的用户会返回海量 ID，contains 检查越滑越贵
布隆过滤器会产生假阴性
分区路由会因此失效
options_en: In an availability-leaning system, recent swipes may not have replicated yet, risking a re-show.
Users with huge swipe histories return massive id sets, making the contains check ever more expensive.
Bloom filters produce false negatives.
Partition routing stops working because of this.
why: 两个软肋：最终一致让新滑动可能没同步齐、被漏掉；重度用户的 ID 集越查越大。分别由客户端缓存和布隆过滤器接棒解决。
why_en: The two weak spots are eventual-consistency gaps in very recent swipes and the ever-growing id set for heavy users.
q_en: What problems come with querying the swipe store for contains filtering?
optionExplanations: 对——偏可用性的系统里，刚写入的滑动可能还没同步到查询命中的副本，就会漏检。
对——滑动历史越长，contains 检查要扫描比对的 ID 集合就越大，越滑越贵。
错——布隆过滤器的设计目标恰恰是绝无假阴性，这与它的真实特性相反。
错——分区路由不受这个过滤方案影响，本身没有失效。
optionExplanations_en: True — in an availability-leaning system, a just-written swipe may not have replicated to the replica being queried, so it slips through.
True — the longer a user's swipe history, the bigger the id set the contains check has to scan, so it gets pricier over time.
False — a Bloom filter is designed to guarantee zero false negatives; that's the opposite of its real behavior.
False — partition routing is unaffected by this filtering approach; nothing about it breaks.

scenario: 近期滑动可能还没同步到所有副本；但在服务端专门为“未落库数据”维护一层缓存又太贵。
q: 近期滑动未完全同步时，应该怎么过滤重复资料？
options: 再加一个后端 Redis 层
客户端缓存最近 K 次滑动并自行过滤
把滑动改成同步强一致写
放弃过滤
options_en: Add yet another backend Redis layer.
Have the client cache the last K swipes and filter locally.
Make swipes a synchronous strongly-consistent write.
Give up on filtering.
why: 把客户端当作系统的一部分：设备端存最近 K 次滑动并自行过滤，比在后端为未同步数据养一层缓存便宜得多。
why_en: Treating the client as part of the system, the device stores the most recent K swipes and filters locally, far cheaper than a backend cache for unsynced data.
whenOtherWins: 若用户会在多台设备上同时使用，客户端缓存彼此不同步，就得回到服务端方案——本题假设单设备成立。
tradeoff: 客户端本地缓存（便宜，依赖单设备假设） vs 后端缓存层（对多设备友好，但运维成本高）
q_en: How should duplicate profiles be filtered when recent swipes are not fully replicated?
scenario_en: Recent swipes may not have replicated to every server yet, but maintaining a server-side cache just for unreplicated swipes is costly.
optionExplanations: 再加一层后端组件正是要避免的额外运维成本，没有绕开同步延迟的根本问题。
对——手机本地记住最近滑过的 K 条、自己过滤，不必在后端为这批还没同步的数据另起一层缓存。
把滑动改成同步强一致写会拖慢全站滑动延迟，代价过大。
放弃过滤会直接违反避免重复展示这条核心非功能需求。
optionExplanations_en: Adding yet another backend layer is exactly the extra operational cost this is trying to avoid, and doesn't fix the sync-delay problem underneath.
Correct — the phone remembers its own recent swipe history and screens locally, without needing a whole extra server-side cache just for this not-yet-synced sliver of data.
Making swipes a synchronous strongly-consistent write would slow down every swipe site-wide, too costly for this.
Giving up on filtering directly violates the core non-functional requirement to avoid re-showing profiles.

q: “让客户端参与过滤”依赖的关键假设是？
options: 客户端存储无限
客户端网络永远在线
假设用户只用一台设备
客户端能直连数据库
options_en: The client has unlimited storage.
The client is always online.
The user is assumed to use only one device.
The client can connect directly to the database.
why: 单设备假设成立，客户端才可靠：它看得到用户全部近期滑动，可以放心承担存储与过滤职责。
why_en: The single-device assumption is what makes the client reliable, since it sees all of the user's recent swipes.
q_en: What key assumption makes client-side filtering acceptable?
optionExplanations: 只需要存最近 K 次滑动，不要求无限容量。
离线时没法过滤是可以接受的边缘情况，不是这个方案依赖的关键假设。
对——只有假设用户只用一台设备，客户端才看得到全部近期滑动，方案才可靠。
客户端从不直连数据库，都经由 API 交互，这不是它依赖的假设。
optionExplanations_en: It only needs to hold the last K swipes, not unlimited capacity.
Being unable to filter while offline is an acceptable edge case, not the key assumption this relies on.
Correct — only if the user has a single device does the client actually see all of their recent swipes, making it reliable.
The client never talks to the database directly; it always goes through the API, so that isn't the assumption here.

q: 用户在 200 张预取资料里滑到约第 150 张时，客户端应该做什么？
options: 直接弹窗强行要求用户先休息一下
立刻清空全部本地缓存里的数据
什么都不做，等滑穿了才处理
提前 ping 后端生成新 feed 并预取
options_en: Pop up a dialog forcing the user to take a break first.
Immediately clear out all the data in the local cache.
Do nothing and only handle it once the stack is exhausted.
Ping the backend early to generate and prefetch the next feed.
why: 客户端缓存的第二重价值：接近滑穿时提前触发后端生成、稍后拉取，并用本地最近滑动继续过滤新 feed，保证无缝衔接。
why_en: The client should ping the backend early to generate the next feed and prefetch it, keeping the swiping experience seamless.
q_en: What should the client do around profile 150 of a 200-profile prefetched stack?
optionExplanations: 弹窗打断体验不是系统该做的事，这不是技术方案。
过早清空缓存会让最近滑动没法继续参与去重过滤。
等滑完再请求，用户会感受到明显的等待和卡顿。
对——提前 ping 后端生成新一叠并预取，保证滑到底之前就已经衔接上。
optionExplanations_en: Popping up a dialog interrupts the experience; that isn't a technical solution.
Clearing the cache too early breaks its ability to keep filtering out recently swiped profiles.
Waiting until the stack is exhausted to request more gives the user a noticeable stall.
Correct — pinging the backend early to generate and prefetch the next batch keeps things seamless before the user hits the bottom.

scenario: 个别重度用户的滑动历史大到缓存放不下、contains 检查也太慢，需要专门手段支撑他们的 feed 过滤。
q: 针对这类用户的（略偏 over-engineered 但成立的）方案是？
options: 历史超阈值时为该用户建布隆过滤器
强制清空他们的滑动历史
限制他们每天最多滑 10 次
为他们单独部署一套数据库
options_en: Build and cache a Bloom filter for that user once history exceeds a threshold.
Force-clear their swipe history.
Cap them at ten swipes a day.
Deploy a dedicated database just for them.
why: 布隆过滤器以极小空间支撑超大集合的成员检查：历史超过阈值就为该用户建过滤器并缓存，feed 构建时快速过滤。
why_en: A Bloom filter supports membership checks over a huge set with very little space, built and cached once a user's history crosses a threshold.
whenOtherWins: 普通用户历史不大，客户端缓存 + contains 检查已足够；布隆过滤器只有在历史巨大时才值得上。
tradeoff: 布隆过滤器（省空间、查询快，但有假阳性） vs 完整 ID contains 检查（精确，但历史越大越慢）

q_en: What specialized option helps heavy swipers with huge history sets?
scenario_en: Some heavy swipers have histories too large for cache and too slow for full contains checks, so feed filtering needs a specialized tool.
optionExplanations: 对——历史超过阈值就为该用户建一个布隆过滤器并缓存，用极小空间换来快速成员检查。
强制清空历史会让用户被重复推荐自己已经滑过的资料，违反核心 NFR。
限制滑动次数是产品层面的妥协，牺牲体验，不是工程解法。
为单个用户单独部署数据库的运维成本和收益完全不成比例。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — once a user's history crosses a threshold, build and cache a Bloom filter for them, trading a little space for fast membership checks.
Force-clearing history would cause the user to be re-shown profiles they already swiped on, breaking the core NFR.
Capping swipe counts is a product-level compromise that sacrifices experience, not an engineering fix.
Standing up a dedicated database for one user is wildly disproportionate to the operational cost.

q: 布隆过滤器用于滑动过滤时，正确性保证是什么？
options: 既有假阳性也有假阴性

可能假阴性但无假阳性
完全精确

It may have false negatives but never false positives.

why_en: Zero false negatives means the system never re-shows a swiped profile, at the cost of a few profiles disappearing due to false positives.

q_en: What correctness guarantee matters when using a Bloom filter for swipe filtering?
optionExplanations: 布隆过滤器的设计目标就是彻底消灭假阴性，这个说法方向不对。
对——假阴性绝不会发生，代价只是极少数资料因假阳性被误判为已滑过。
这与布隆过滤器的真实特性正好相反，假阴性才是它承诺消除的。
布隆过滤器天生是概率型结构，不是精确结构，这也是它省空间的原因。

Correct — false negatives never happen; the cost is that a small number of profiles get wrongly flagged as already-swiped.

A Bloom filter is inherently probabilistic, not exact — that's precisely why it's space-efficient.

Mainly determined by network bandwidth.

过滤器读写发生在 Redis 或内存层，不会直接冲击 Cassandra。
对——每次新滑动都要更新过滤器，节点故障后重建虽然可行，规模化下开销很大。
optionExplanations_en: A Bloom filter is a generic data structure implementable in any mainstream language; that's not a real limitation.
The filtering itself is just a few hash computations and is fast; that's not where the problem lies.
The filter's reads and writes live in Redis or memory, not on Cassandra's write path.

q: 对重度滑动用户，“布隆过滤器”与“完整 ID contains 检查”的核心取舍维度是？
options: 空间/速度 vs 精确性
开源 vs 闭源
强一致 vs 最终一致
本地 vs 云端

Open source versus closed source.
Strong consistency versus eventual consistency.
On-device versus cloud-hosted.
why: 一句话对比：布隆过滤器用可控的不精确换空间与速度；contains 检查零误差，但成本随历史线性膨胀。
why_en: The Bloom filter trades a controlled amount of inaccuracy for space and speed, while the exact contains check has zero error but scales linearly with history.
tradeoff: 布隆过滤器（省空间、快，有假阳性） vs 完整 contains 检查（精确，历史越大越慢）
q_en: For heavy swipers, what is the core tradeoff between a Bloom filter and full ID contains checks?

开源许可协议和这里的工程取舍完全无关。
两种方案讨论的都是集合成员检查，不是复制一致性问题。
